# Cncf Kepler Reviewer

Review Kepler using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. Kepler (Kubernetes-based Efficient Power Level Exporter) uses eBPF to probe energy related system stats and exports as Prometheus metrics.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
